CommunityApplications.Profile: This repository holds **Clockspan**, a self-hosted, single-day focus sheet for a workday with ADHD: a punch-style timeclock with lunch and clock-out alarms, the day's priorities, and a focus timer that logs what you did. The README covers setup, sign-in modes and backups. Questions and bug reports go to [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/geransmith/clockspan/issues).
